description: Glowmere over four times the ground: every weight is glowmere-medium's, so the per-square-metre density and the proportions between the species are unchanged, and the extent is doubled to 840 m. The mid and background view distances are fixed in metres, so a larger world puts more of itself inside them -- this is the rung that dials the geometry the scene pass pays for without touching the art direction. The terrain grows with it: 441 chunks against medium's 121.

certification.what: Dense Forest, the first of §45's four stress profiles: four times the ground at the reference density. One of the two rungs docs/renderer-2-benchmark-world.md §6 concludes a regression should be judged on -- it reproduces across passes to within half a per cent.
certification.declares: The counters below are what this rung submits at the resolution, tier and camera named here, and they are checked exactly by tools/certify.py. They can be: a composition is a pure function of (recipe, library, seed) and the culling decision a pure function of that plus the camera and the resolution, so an unequal count is a real change every time and carries no noise floor to argue about. The frame times are measured in the same run and are deliberately NOT declared -- a millisecond is a property of a session (01-audit-and-baseline.md §3.1), and a declared one would be a cross-session comparison with the other session hidden inside a constant.
